name: morphing-button-group
summary: Buttons that split, join and stretch between sets — with a signature sheet built on it.
props: MorphingButtonGroup: the buttons to show now; changing it morphs the row.
behavior: Buttons with the same key keep their place and resize; new ones grow in from nothing and leaving ones shrink away, on one smooth ease (no bounce).
A label change cross-fades while the button resizes.
The pad draws smoothed strokes; undo removes the last one, Reset clears, Confirm asks once more. onConfirm gets SVG path data and the pad size.
A tick on each button, a light tap opening the sheet, success on confirm.
